attributes.law_screen: attempt.parked.damage-enemy-p6-goto-pair.20260831.v1 SCREENED FIRST as the governing park; its do-not-retry list covers if-goto/goto, if-else-goto, switch-goto, break/continue, label-separated and empty-block spellings, i.e. every way of separating the conditional from the adjacent unconditional jump. The merged-disjunction form is none of those - it COMBINES two guards into one condition rather than re-spelling one guard's body - so the revisit was legitimate under the AGENTS.md rule that a park may be revisited on a genuinely new source-level idea. claim.law.DE_merged-disjunction-unfuses-a-forward-guard-pair-only-into-the-epilogue.20260901.v1 is the law this measurement BOUNDS, and is proposed alongside this record. claim.law.empty-block-branch-pair-splits-forward-vs-backedge.20260831.v1 SCREENED: this site is the FORWARD variant (the b targets 0x5d0, ahead, reached from three places), so the law does classify it as workable - the refutation here narrows that. claim.law.insn-count-parity-outranks-local-opcode-fidelity.20260831.v1 SCREENED and DECISIVE for arbitration: both forms improved the multiset 4t -> 3t while breaking parity to O570 against T571, and parity plus real both favour the baseline. claim.law.guard-polarity-restructure-fixes-count-parity-not-form.20260831.v1 SCREENED - it is what the RETAINED baseline form already exploits, as the in-source comment records.
attributes.residual: NOTHING RETAINED; baseline restored at real 66, insns EXACT 571/571, multiset 4t, fuzzy 99.2207 - the park's v1 best is unchanged and still the best form. THE REFUTATION, which is the deliverable: the merged-disjunction lever does NOT transfer from fn_8004DB3C to damage_enemy even though the two sites are the same forward-variant pair, in the same TU, with the same `A && B` guard shape. Both spellings produced BYTE-IDENTICAL output to each other (real 151, T571/O570, one surviving cluster `T@5ac bne+b` vs `O@5ac beq`), which is two identical A/Bs and closes the axis. THE DISCRIMINANT, now named: in fn_8004DB3C the merged guard's body is `return`, so its exit is the FUNCTION EPILOGUE - a block the front end has already materialised because other guards reach it - and that satisfies the parent law's requirement that the pair's far target be genuinely reached from elsewhere. In damage_enemy the exit is an INTERIOR merge point (0x5d0, the end of the if-block), and a label that exists only for this guard does not get its own basic block, so MWCC folds the pair to `beq` regardless of how the condition is spelled. CONFIRMS AND EXTENDS THE PARK: the do-not-retry list should now also carry the merged-disjunction form, in both its structured (De Morgan, empty-else) and goto spellings. SECOND MEASURED FACT, independently useful: our baseline's ours-only `cror eq,lt,eq` at 0x5a4 is the unordered-safe lowering of the NEGATED comparison `e->health <= upper`, while target's `bgt` is the positive `e->health > upper`; the two differ on NaN. Spelling the comparison positively does close that cluster (multiset 4t -> 3t, form 1) but costs the instruction-count parity the retained form buys, exactly as the in-source comment and the park both record - so the `cror` is the PRICE of parity here, not an independent defect.
